title: Monotone Property Thresholds
summary: This paper was originally written by the authors circa 2005 but was never submitted for publication. The present version corrects minor errors, adds references to work published since the original draft, and includes a section discussing further research directions. The core framework -- the property function $ψ_G$, the density function $\varphi^ψ_μ$, and all threshold results -- is unchanged from the original.
